preamble.summary: Psalm 2 — the Royal-Messianic 'You are my Son; today I have begotten you' (cited at Acts 13:33, Heb 1:5, 5:5). Sparse fragmentary attestation; tracks MT.
preamble.notable_variants: Cited Christologically across the New Testament. No significant content variants. Minor orthographic variation only (the standard Qumran plene-spelling tendency).
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary attestation; no continuous DSS coverage.
